meta.title: The Spaceship in the Garden
meta.textType: story: an imagined trip told slowly with pauses

paragraphs: On Saturday afternoon, Lily finds a very big box in the garden. "It is a spaceship!" she says. Tom helps her paint it gold and silver. He designs a round window for the front. Then he invents a red wheel for the engine. Pip sits in the front of the box. Lily is the astronaut, and Tom is the engineer. Lily draws a big yellow star on the side. Then she puts on a paper helmet.

Lily and Tom count down from ten to one, and then they shout, "Go!" "Where are we going?" asks Tom. "We will fly to a new planet," says Lily. "We will explore a big desert, and we will find treasure." "Can we go anywhere?" asks Tom. "Yes, anywhere," says Lily, "but today we will go somewhere new." Pip jumps up and down.

Tom turns the red wheel, and Pip says, "Woof!" Tom looks through the round window. "I see a big blue planet," he says. "The spaceship is very fast," says Tom. "I am not afraid," says Lily, "because I am not alone." "You and Pip are with me." "There may be a robot in the desert," says Tom. "A friendly robot will help us," says Lily. Tom and Lily laugh.

Lily looks up at the sky. She holds the edge of the box with both hands. "In the future, I will be an astronaut," she says. "I will fly to the moon." "This is a good adventure," says Tom. The last picture shows the spaceship above a yellow desert. The picture ends before the landing. What will they find in the desert? You can guess.
text.summary: Lily and Tom make a spaceship from a big box in the garden. They imagine a trip to a new planet, and the story stops before they land.
